data_source.description:
`data/raw_data.npz` stores the measured Fourier observations and legitimate independent calibration. No spatial voxel or acquisition cycle was removed. Frequency selection was fixed from independent calibration SNR and the source acquisition's80kHz high-pass convention; no target geometry or target-derived calibration is provided.

| Key | Shape | Dtype | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| calibration | (1,7116,6859) | complex64 | Native independent delta-sample Fourier responses in instrument a.u.; axes batch, selected frequency/channel row, voxel with x fastest. |
| calibration_background | (1,7116,362) | complex64 | Native independent empty-bore calibration responses in instrument a.u.; all362 background frames. |
| foreground | (1,1000,7116) | complex128 | Unscaled Fourier amplitudes of all1000 specimen cycles in instrument a.u.; axes batch, cycle, selected row. |
| background | (1,1000,7116) | complex128 | Unscaled Fourier amplitudes of all1000 empty-bore observation cycles in instrument a.u.; same row order. |
| frequency | (1,7116) | float64 | Frequency of each selected Fourier row in Hz; repeated across receive channels. |
| channel | (1,7116) | uint8 | Zero-based receive-channel index0,1,2, dimensionless; ordered channel first then ascending frequency. |
| calibration_snr | (1,7116) | float64 | Author-supplied independent calibration SNR for each retained row, dimensionless. |
| voxel_positions | (1,6859,3) | float64 | Voxel-center coordinates in meters, columns x,y,z; x-fastest ordering matching calibration. |

**Acquisition metadata**

| Parameter | Value | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| Instrument | Bruker/Philips preclinical FFP scanner | dimensionless identifier | Actual2018 author measurements, not simulated data. |
| Tracer | Perimag, iron solute | dimensionless identifier | Same tracer in independent delta calibration and specimen. |
| Selection-field gradient | diagonal(-1,-1,2) | T/m | Three-axis static encoding gradient. |
| Drive-field amplitude | (12,12,12) | mT | Three sinusoidal excitation components. |
| Drive-field frequency | 2.5MHz divided by(102,96,99) | Hz | x,y,z drive frequencies; all phases pi/2 radians. |
| Acquisition cycle | 0.0215424 | seconds | One complete3-D Lissajous cycle. |
| Native samples per cycle | 53856 | samples/channel | Entire native time record transformed without temporal padding. |
| Receiver sample rate | 2500000 | Hz | Twice the1.25MHz receiver bandwidth. |
| Receiver channels | 3 | channels | All receive directions retained subject to calibration-only frequency selection. |
| Fourier frequency | k/(0.0215424), k=0,...,26928 | Hz | Unscaled real FFT of native cycles; stored rows identify k through frequency. |
| Selected rows | frequency>80000 and native calibration SNR>2; Nyquist omitted | Hz / dimensionless | All qualifying rows from all3 channels,7116 total; no target-dependent mask. |
| Calibration spatial grid | (19,19,19) | voxels | Full native grid, including overscan outside the driven field. |
| Calibration field of view | (38,38,19) | mm | Native MDF calibration extent, not the smaller drive-field excursion. |
| Drive-field extent | (24,24,12) | mm | Derived from drive amplitudes and selection gradient. |
| Grid center | (0,0,0) | mm | Voxel centers x/y=-18,-16,...,18mm; z=-9,-8,...,9mm. |
| Delta sample | (2,2,1)mm,4 microliters,0.1mol(Fe)/L | mm / microliters / mol/L | Independent calibration amount0.4micromol Fe. |
| Stored calibration averaging | 100 | native averages/frame | As recorded by MDF; stored Fourier amplitudes already represent that acquisition averaging. |
| Specimen / empty-bore cycles | 1000 /1000 | cycles | All cycles supplied; benchmark reconstructs their static averaged distribution. |
| Calibration backgrounds | 362 | frames | Separate empty-bore frames acquired throughout calibration. |
| Receive transfer correction | not supplied/applied | dimensionless | Calibration and specimen share the same receive-chain convention. |
| Spatial boundary | full finite calibration grid | mm | No extrapolation, periodic spatial wrapping or implicit voxel crop. |

data_source.description:
`data/raw_data.npz` contains measured observations only:

| Key | Shape | Dtype | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| displacement | (1, 2, 48, 49) | float64 | Measured ux,uy in original fluorescent-image pixels; multiply by 0.201 µm/pixel. Axes batch, component (x,y), increasing physical y, increasing physical x. |

**Acquisition metadata**

| Parameter | Value | Unit | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Fluorescent-image pixel size | 0.201 | µm/pixel | Metric calibration of measured displacement amplitudes. |
| Displacement sample pitch | 8.040000000000001 | µm | Stored float64 value of 40 × 0.201; equal x/y spacing. |
| PIV interrogation width | 100 | image pixels | Gaussian subpixel cross-correlation of bead image pairs. |
| PIV overlap | 60 | image pixels | Adjacent measurement centres differ by 40 image pixels. |
| Original bead-image size | 1989 × 2034 | image pixels | Entire experimental image pair underlying the observed field. |
| Displacement array size | 48 × 49 | grid samples | Entire PIV measurement field, without selecting a favourable region. |
| Young's modulus E | 49000.0 | Pa | Polyacrylamide substrate elasticity. |
| Poisson ratio ν | 0.49 | dimensionless | Nearly incompressible substrate. |
| Layer thickness h | 300.0 | µm | Bonded elastic substrate thickness. |
| Coordinates | x right; y upward | dimensionless | Displacement field rows increase physically upward; original image rows were reversed without changing signed component values. |
| Origin | Lower-left displacement sample | dimensionless | Translation-invariant elastic model; absolute image origin is not required. |
| Noise | No calibrated pointwise variance | image pixels | PIV peak-ratio validation and local-mean outlier replacement precede the supplied observation. |
| Boundary convention | Zero-padded even square; periodic FFT | dimensionless | Place data at the final rows/columns of a 50×50 grid, then crop to the same support. |

The physical y convention and exact PIV sampling step are stated explicitly. This calibrated application of the published elastic method does not claim an unchanged pixelwise reproduction of a tutorial that uses approximate image-size-based sampling.

The input is `data/raw_data.npz`; all arrays include batch size one.

| Key | Shape | Dtype | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `microphone_signal` | `(1, 25600, 56)` | `float32` | Native float32 uncalibrated sensor signal in instrument units; axes (batch, time, channel). |
| `microphone_position` | `(1, 56, 3)` | `float64` | Author-calibrated microphone coordinates in m; axes (batch, channel, Cartesian x/y/z). |
| `calibration_factor` | `(1, 56)` | `float64` | Per-channel multiplier in Pa/instrument-unit, available instrument calibration. |

**Acquisition metadata**

| Parameter | Value | Unit | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Sample frequency | 51200 | Hz | Exact stored HDF5 sample_freq attribute |
| Samples | 25600 | 1 | Full available record, duration 0.5 s |
| Invalid channels | Zero-based indices 1 and 7 | 1 | Author-known excluded sensors; 54 valid channels |
| Sound speed | 346.04 | m/s | Quiescent free-field propagation model |
| Source-plane x centers | -0.6 to 0 in increments 0.05 | m | 13 x samples |
| Source-plane y centers | -0.3 to 0.3 in increments 0.05 | m | 13 y samples |
| Source-plane z | -0.68 | m | Relative to array coordinate origin |
| Band center / division | 4000 / 3 | Hz / 1 | Third octave: [4000/2^(1/6),4000*2^(1/6)) |
| Spectral block | 128 | samples | Hann window; 50% overlap; no mean subtraction |
| Spectrum normalization | 2/(128 sum(window²) number_of_blocks) | 1 | One-sided per-bin mean-square pressure, not Pa²/Hz |
| Cross-spectrum convention | FFT[p_m] conjugate(FFT[p_n]) | Pa² | Hermitian C[m,n] |
| Diagonal treatment | Remove and multiply M/(M-1) | 1 | Reduce incoherent sensor contribution |
| Boundary / flow | Unbounded free field; zero mean flow | 1 | No wall reflections or shear-layer refraction modeled |

Generate and prepare the microscope_denoising benchmark dataset.

Downloads the 2D fluorescence microscopy example data from Zenodo
(DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.7261163) and packages it into the standard npz format.

Dataset: TIRF fluorescence images of Microtubules acquired at low-SNR
conditions on a Multi-SIM system (Qiao et al., Nat. Commun. 2024).

Output layout:
  data/raw_data.npz      - key "measurements": shape (55, 502, 502), float32
                            55 noisy TIRF Microtubule images, background ~100 ADU,
                            average signal ~10 ADU above background.
  data/ground_truth.npz  - key "psf": shape (1, 32, 32), float32
                            Center-cropped, normalised PSF kernel used for
                            Stage 2 (deconvolution) training and evaluation.
  data/meta_data.json    - imaging parameters and noise model estimates.
data_source.description:
### `data/raw_data.npz`

| Key | Shape | Dtype | Description |
|-----|-------|-------|-------------|
| `measurements` | (55, 502, 502) | float32 | 55 noisy TIRF Microtubule images. Camera background ~100 ADU; mean signal above background ~10 ADU (very low SNR). Each frame is an independent low-SNR acquisition. |
| `psf` | (1, 32, 32) | float32 | Center-cropped, unit-sum PSF kernel for the Microtubule channel (525 nm emission, NA 1.3, pixel size 0.0313 µm). Used in Stage 2 deconvolution training and PSF-residual evaluation. |

### `data/baseline_reference.npz`

No `ground_truth.npz` is provided for this task; since all 55 frames are from different cells (no pixel-level reference exists), `data/baseline_reference.npz` contains the ZS-DeconvNet outputs from the reference run (30 000 iterations), used for NCC/NRMSE evaluation.

| Key | Shape | Dtype | Description |
|-----|-------|-------|-------------|
| `denoised` | (1, 502, 502) | float32 | Stage 1 denoised output for frame 01 |
| `deconvolved` | (1, 502, 502) | float32 | Stage 2 deconvolved output for frame 01 |

### `data/meta_data.json`

| Field | Value | Description |
|-------|-------|-------------|
| `modality` | `"TIRF fluorescence microscopy"` | Total internal reflection fluorescence |
| `structure` | `"Microtubule (filamentous)"` | Cytoskeletal filaments ~25 nm diameter |
| `pixel_size_um` | 0.0313 | Lateral pixel size in micrometres |
| `emission_wavelength_nm` | 525 | Fluorescence emission wavelength |
| `na` | 1.3 | Numerical aperture |
| `background_adu` | 100 | Camera bias offset $b$ |
| `noise_model.beta1_estimated` | ~0.75 | Poissonian factor (estimated from data) |
| `noise_model.beta2_estimated` | ~3.7 | Read noise variance (estimated from data) |
| `noise_model.alpha_recorruption` | 1.5 | Recorruption noise strength $\alpha$ |
| `psf.kernel_size` | 32 | PSF kernel size in pixels |

| Parameter | Value | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|

| Background relative permittivity | 4.0 | dimensionless | Known lossless homogeneous medium |

| Background wavelength | 0.4996540966663685 | m | Deposited wavelength convention |
| Incident amplitude | 1.0 | normalized electric-field unit | Phase-calibrated plane waves |
| Time convention | exp(+i omega t) | dimensionless | Outgoing Green function uses Hankel second kind |
| Image region | x and y each[−0.4,+0.4] | m | Finite square support in an unbounded background |
| Output grid | 30 y-cells by30 x-cells | cell | Physical cell means, no artificial display resolution |
| Output cell pitch | 0.8/30 | m | Equal Cartesian cell widths |
| Cell coordinates | half-cell offsets, x and y increasing with array index | m | Row-major flattening, y-cell then x-cell |
| Receiver radius | 1.0 | m | Circular acquisition geometry centered at the origin |
| Receiver count | 9 | receiver | All deposited receiver samples retained |

references:
Synthetic Dynamic DCE-MRI Data Generation
==========================================

Creates a time-varying 128x128 phantom with contrast agent uptake,
generates per-frame variable-density Cartesian undersampled k-space,
and adds complex Gaussian noise.

Phantom design:
    - Static background: elliptical body + inner structures (Shepp-Logan-like)
    - Dynamic component: two small enhancing regions that follow a
      gamma-variate contrast uptake curve with different timing parameters

The gamma-variate model for concentration is:
    C(t) = A * ((t - t_arrival) / t_peak)^alpha * exp(-alpha * (t - t_arrival) / t_peak)
    for t > t_arrival, else 0.

The ground truth is the MVUE image, computed as:

$$x_{\text{mvue}} = \frac{\sum_c \bar{S}_c \cdot \mathcal{F}^{-1}(y_c^{\text{full}})}{\sqrt{\sum_c |S_c|^2}}$$

- Original code: https://github.com/pyspeckit/pyspeckit ; exact archived commit `92c69bfdad2980a915a53007b03d8910e10b6bba`. A new shallow clone was acquired by the parent coordinator, then copied to the private archive; `git rev-parse HEAD` confirms this revision and `git status --short` was empty. A later `git ls-remote ... HEAD` attempt failed to connect; no claim is made that this revision remains the latest remote HEAD. The oracle imports the unchanged source directly, as recorded by its `__file__`, rather than an installed similarly named distribution.
- Optional exploratory test repository: https://github.com/pyspeckit/pyspeckit-tests ; newly cloned revision `c11ed9b3747a7b5bc18a48340ca3c2f207cd8c85`. Its test spectra were inspected but are NOT the bound data and are not redistributed. No license is inferred for its independent data.
- Method paper: Ginsburg et al., AJ 163, 291 (2022), DOI https://doi.org/10.3847/1538-3881/ac695a . Archived paper is arXiv `2205.04987v1`; exact arXiv metadata response and PDF are private. Task-relevant sections: spectral models and nonlinear fitting, hyperfine model, Appendix C/C1-C2, and background-subtracted transfer expression D6. Published historical CLASS table values are not asserted to be measurements of this run.
- Data paper: Andre, Belloche, Motte & Peretto, A&A 472, 519 (2007), catalogue `J/A+A/472/519`. Actual source: https://cdsarc.cds.unistra.fr/ftp/J/A+A/472/519/fits/opha_n2h.fit ; catalogue description: https://cdsarc.cds.unistra.fr/ftp/J/A+A/472/519/ReadMe . The description explicitly identifies IRAM 30m on-the-fly real N2H+ cubes of six Ophiuchus cores, approximately 26 arcsec resolution, OphA 20 kHz spectral resolution. The data paper PDF endpoint returned HTTP 403; the available observational paper identity and data description are the archived CDS record, not an invented successful paper download. The selected method paper PDF was obtained and read.
- Original FITS shape `(1,501,30,21)`, float32, BUNIT=K, OBJECT=VLA1623A, ORIGIN=GILDAS-(LAOG-IRAM). `DATE-OBS=2007-07-04` and DATE/HISTORY indicate file-writing metadata, and are NOT claimed to prove the actual observing date. Core and acquisition claims come from the catalogue description. Original FITS SHA-256: `9f9331ab9fb240276dfdb5d8a5938b7063c824f58490813b7f81d6a8ff4b5065`.
- Bound brightness: `original[0,:,25:28,12:15]`, preserving all 501 channels. Original float32 values are promoted exactly to float64. Velocity is `((index+1)-403.0960083008)*(-62.84131109715)/1000+2.5` km/s; frequency is `93176265000*(1-velocity/299792.458)` Hz. No smoothing, interpolation, baseline fit, noise injection or target selection from cleaned results occurs.
- Molecular calibration is selected upstream J=1-0 constants, derived from laboratory frequencies/relative strengths, not estimated from a hidden cloud target. Explicitly preserve the upstream sum of strengths and component-dependent Doppler convention. Input arrays were appended to the observation-only NPZ after the independently bound original run; observation/frequency values are identical. Final NPZ and individual array fingerprints below remove ambiguity about package versus numeric data hashes.

VizieR states that retrieved data are free of usage in a scientific context with explicit citation of the original authors, publication and publisher. Commercial usage depends on the originating publisher's terms. This task does not relicense the observations under the code's MIT license. The archival data README contains no separate dataset copyright statement. Source and terms: https://cdsarc.cds.unistra.fr/viz-bin/cat/J/A+A/472/519 and https://cds.unistra.fr/vizier-org/licences_vizier.html .
data_source.description:
`data/raw_data.npz` contains existing experimental observations and molecular calibration. No simulated observations are generated.

| Key | Shape | Dtype | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| brightness | (1, 501, 3, 3) | float64 | Measured brightness in K; batch, frequency, y, x; original float32 values promoted without resampling. |
| frequency | (1, 501) | float64 | Channel frequencies in Hz, increasing along channel index. |
| hyperfine_velocity_offsets | (1, 15) | float64 | Laboratory component offsets d in km/s, with the ordering used by the strength vector. |
| hyperfine_relative_strengths | (1, 15) | float64 | Relative strengths w, dimensionless; normalize by their actual sum (0.9999990000000001). |

**Acquisition metadata**

| Parameter | Value | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| Telescope | IRAM 30m | none | Single-dish spectral mapping of OphA, on-the-fly acquisition. |
| Angular resolution | approximately 26 | arcsec | Telescope beam, not pixel spacing. |
| Spatial sampling | 7.50000019203 | arcsec | Pixel pitch in x and y. |
| Axis orientation | increasing x decreases projected right ascension; increasing y increases declination | none | Original ARC sky-projection array orientation; no periodic spatial boundary. |
| Bound spatial indices | y=25,26,27; x=12,13,14 | zero-based pixel | Contiguous crop of the released CDS cube. |
| Original reference sky coordinate | RA=246.6102288723; Dec=-24.40855924977 | deg | J2000 ARC projection reference. |
| Original spatial reference pixel | x=14.93333352010; y=9.153333173918 | one-based pixel | Reference pixels in the original 21 by 30 grid. |
| Original velocity reference | 2.5 at channel pixel 403.0960083008 | km/s, one-based pixel | FITS velocity-axis calibration. |
| Velocity increment | -0.06284131109715 | km/s | Original consecutive-channel spacing. |
| Radio reference frequency | 93176265000 | Hz | Supplied channel frequencies equal this value times (1-u/c), with u the original radio velocity. |
| Component reference frequency f_c | 93173763700 | Hz | Reference for the 15 molecular component offsets; distinct from the radio-axis reference. |
| Light speed c | 299792.458 | km/s | Doppler conversion convention. |
| Planck constant h | 6.62607015e-34 | J s | Exact SI value. |
| Boltzmann constant k | 1.380649e-23 | J/K | Exact SI value. |
| Background temperature T_b | 2.73 | K | Uniform cosmic microwave background model. |
| Beam filling | 1 | dimensionless | Uniform slab approximation. |
| Spectrometer resolution | 20 | kHz | Published OphA nominal instrumental resolution; use channel samples directly without additional convolution. |

data_source.description:
The bound observation is the complete `scene026/blur/blur_3.png` camera exposure from the RealBlur-J dataset, converted to the integer luminance channel of the full-range YCrCb convention, then divided by 255. It has not been resized, cropped, synthetically blurred or corrupted with additional noise. RealBlur-J is processed JPEG-domain data distributed in PNG containers. Dataset registration and intensity processing predate this task; this is not raw sensor radiance.

| Key | Shape | Dtype | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `observation` | `(1, 753, 668)` | `float32` | Real processed exposure luminance, dimensionless relative full scale; axes batch, row, column |

**Acquisition metadata**

| Parameter | Value | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| Source modality | Sony A7R3 real camera exposure | none | Measured handheld motion blur, not a numerical blur simulation |
| Spatial sampling | 753 rows by 668 columns | pixel | Complete distributed image raster; row increases downward and column rightward |
| Photometric convention | Integer full-range YCrCb luminance divided by 255 | relative full scale | Quantized processed intensity; no linear-radiance claim |
| Luminance conversion | `(4899 R + 9617 G + 1868 B + 8192) >> 14` | integer DN | RGB channels have 8-bit range; divide the integer result by 255 |
| Quantization step | `1/255` | relative full scale | Precision of the distributed luminance observation |
| Assumed kernel support | 51 by 51 | pixel | Specified finite-support blind forward-model assumption, not a measured calibration |
| Latent model extent | 803 rows by 718 columns | pixel | Adds a 25-pixel latent boundary on each side to model the complete measurement |
| Forward boundary convention | Valid cross-correlation | none | No circular convolution; no observed boundary padding |
| Kernel origin convention | Index `(25,25)` corresponds to the reported image origin | pixel | Translation remains ambiguous within the specified gauge |
| Exposure trajectory and noise variance | Unknown | none | Must not be assumed calibrated; structured residuals may remain |
| Pixel pitch and exposure time | Not supplied with this sample | none | Neither is needed for the pixel-domain model; no metric displacement or radiometric inference is requested |

data_source.description:
`data/raw_data.npz` contains all 408 measured points, in their original precision and ordering.

| Key | Shape | Dtype | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| q | (1, 408) | float64 | Momentum transfer Q, Angstrom^-1; axes (batch, observation). |
| reflectivity | (1, 408) | float64 | Measured specular intensity ratio, dimensionless; axes (batch, observation). |
| standard_error | (1, 408) | float64 | One standard deviation reflectivity uncertainty, dimensionless; axes (batch, observation). |
| q_fwhm | (1, 408) | float64 | Point dependent Gaussian Q resolution FWHM, Angstrom^-1; axes (batch, observation). |

**Acquisition metadata**

| Parameter | Value | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| Instrument | PLATYPUS | — | Neutron reflectometer; supplied curve is already reduced to specular reflectivity. |
| Fronting SLD | 2.07 | 10^-6 Angstrom^-2 | Semi-infinite silicon incident medium. |
| Oxide SLD | 3.47 | 10^-6 Angstrom^-2 | Fixed uniform native oxide layer SLD. |
| Backing SLD | 6.36 | 10^-6 Angstrom^-2 | Semi-infinite heavy water exit medium. |
| Imaginary SLD | 0 | Angstrom^-2 | Absorption neglected for all four media. |
| Depth origin | 0 | Angstrom | Silicon/native oxide interface. |
| Positive depth | silicon toward water | — | Layer order: silicon, oxide, film, water. |
| Lateral convention | uniform layers | — | Specular approximation, laterally averaged structure. |
| Interface convention | Nevot–Croce | — | Gaussian roughness damping of interface amplitudes. |
| Resolution model | Gaussian, per observation FWHM | Angstrom^-1 | Widths supplied by q_fwhm; sigma = FWHM/(2 sqrt(2 ln(2))). |
| Boundary convention | semi-infinite fronting and backing | — | No second reflection beyond bounding media. |
| Noise information | supplied standard errors | dimensionless | Independent point uncertainty approximation; residual systematics may remain. |

The supplied Q values and widths are sufficient to formulate the reduced measurement model; unreleased wavelength or detector geometry is not required. No extra calibration observations are assumed.

| Key | Shape | Dtype | Description |

| fringes | (1, 2, 1600, 1024) | uint16 | Native detector ADU; axes batch, detector channel, sweep sample, A-line |

| chirp | (1, 800) | float64 | Dimensionless normalized spectral calibration coordinate, native deposited calibration convention |
| dispersion | (1, 1600) | float32 | Dimensionless complex spectral phase correction encoded as first 800 real parts then 800 imaginary parts |

**Acquisition metadata**

| Parameter | Value | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| Detector sample rate | 180 | MHz | Deposited capture clock |
| Sweep samples per detector | 1600 | sample | Native digitization length |
| A-lines | 1024 | line | Complete recorded lateral scan; no circumferential resampling |
| Detector channels | 2 | channel | Polarization-diverse detection, native channel order |
| Recorded B scans | 1 | B scan | Entire deposited selected acquisition |
| ADC | unsigned 16-bit, little endian | ADU | Original digitizer representation |
| Input voltage range | 2200 | mV | Deposited channel A and B voltage setting |
| Analytic spectral support | first 800 DFT bins | bin | Positive-frequency half of native spectral DFT |
| Carrier | 400 | native DFT bin | Heterodyne frequency offset |
| Spectral zoom | 2 | dimensionless | Oversampled analytic fringe representation |
| Depth bins | 2048 | bin | Full calibrated image depth grid |
| Phase convention | negative-sign forward DFT | dimensionless | Complex quadratures retained |
| Boundaries | finite spectral aperture, zero extension | dimensionless | No spatial circular extension of anatomy |
| Lateral/depth physical pitch | not deposited | unavailable | Coordinates are A-line and depth-bin indices |
| Wavelength and absolute optical power | not deposited | unavailable | Calibrated normalized spectral coordinates define the digital reconstruction |
| Noise variance | not independently calibrated | unavailable | No invented Gaussian/Poisson variance |

data_source.description:
The two images are supplied particle-image examples from the OpenPIV software distribution, preserved without resizing or generated blur. The distribution calls its example a real PIV demonstration, but it does not establish the apparatus, original acquisition date or calibrated physical frame spacing. Treat these as repository-provided observations with incomplete experimental provenance.

| Key | Shape | Dtype | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| frame_a | (1, 369, 511) | uint8 | First monochrome particle image, digital counts from 0 to 255; axes batch, row, column. |
| frame_b | (1, 369, 511) | uint8 | Second monochrome particle image, digital counts from 0 to 255; axes batch, row, column. |

**Acquisition metadata**

| Parameter | Value | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| Image origin | top left | pixel | x is column, y is row; both positive toward increasing array index. |
| Spatial calibration | 1 | image pixel/pixel | No physical length calibration is available. |
| Frame spacing | 1 | frame interval | Relative timing convention; elapsed seconds are unavailable. |
| Search support | 64 by 64 | pixel | Fixed neighborhood defining each output location and correlation support. |
| Interrogation support | 32 by 32 | pixel | Central square of frame A in the 64-square neighborhood. |
| Neighbor overlap | 16 | pixel | Search windows overlap by this amount, giving grid step 48. |
| Grid x centers | 32 + 48 j, j=0,...,9 | pixel | Centers of actual extracted windows, without shifting the image or recentering unused margins. |
| Grid y centers | 32 + 48 i, i=0,...,6 | pixel | Centers of actual extracted windows. |
| Intensity response | stored digital counts | count | No radiometric calibration or sensor-noise distribution is supplied. |
| Boundary convention | circular within each 64-square map | pixel | Periodic correlation; no image-edge padding; unmatched trailing margins are unused. |
| Confidence exclusion | square half-width 2 | correlation pixel | Exclude the 5 by 5 neighborhood centered on the first peak when finding the second. |
| Peak stability offset | 0.0000001 | normalized correlation | Added to each correlation map after finding an interior peak, before subpixel fitting and confidence measurement. |

The confidence observable is the maximum correlation divided by the largest correlation outside the exclusion square. An edge maximum or first-peak height below 0.001 has confidence zero. A zero second peak, or a second peak on the edge whose height exceeds half the first, also yields zero. These conventions define the requested auxiliary quantity, not a calibrated probability of correctness.

data_source.description:
The observations are the released experimental Fresnel lens example associated
with the reference below. They are repository-distributed image exports, already
processed and lossy encoded upstream, rather than original raw sensor files.
The supplied arrays preserve all released grayscale pixels without new spatial
cropping, resizing, noise injection or intensity normalization. No independent
physical irradiance or object-plane magnification calibration is available.

| Key | Shape | Dtype | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| holograms | (1, 4, 1024, 1024) | uint8 | Four quarter-cycle phase-shifted measured intensities in DN, ordered phase 0, pi/2, pi, 3pi/2; axes batch, phase, row, column. |

**Acquisition metadata**

| Parameter | Value | Unit | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Illumination wavelength | 632.8e-9 | m | Illumination value supplied with the experimental example. |
| Camera pitch x | 6.9e-6 | m/pixel | Sensor column spacing. |
| Camera pitch y | 6.9e-6 | m/pixel | Sensor row spacing. |
| Frame phase increments | pi/2 | rad | Nominal reference phase increase between adjacent frames, introduced using a liquid lens. |
| Image rows and columns | 1024 by 1024 | pixel | Released spatial extent; no additional padding. |
| Frame count | 4 | dimensionless | Same sample and nominal geometry. |
| Pixel coordinate origin | x = column - N/2; y = row - M/2 | pixel | Half-array-centered coordinates, not (N-1)/2. Rows increase downward. |
| Diffraction order | upper half-plane | dimensionless | Select the upper object-order peak, excluding the central DC order. |
| Discrete transform | negative exponential, no forward normalization | dimensionless | Forward FFT uses a pre-shift and a post-shift; full finite camera window, no taper or padding. |
| Boundary convention | finite camera window; periodic DFT extension | dimensionless | Applies only to spectral carrier estimation; no spatial propagation. |
| Noise calibration | not supplied | DN | No calibrated likelihood or known Gaussian noise variance is assumed. |
| Physical scale | released 8-bit grayscale intensity | DN | Upstream image exports; no conversion to optical power or lens thickness. |

data_source.description:
Two real ultrasound datasets are included, both acquired with a 128-element linear transducer (SonixRP, Ultrasonix Medical), sampling frequency 20 MHz, element pitch 298 µm, speed of sound 1540 m/s, 7 compounding angles (−1.5° to +1.5° in 0.5° steps).

### `data/raw_data.npz`

| Key | Shape | Dtype | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `RF_fibers` | (1, 2688, 128, 7) | float32 | RF signals in raw 8-bit ADC counts, nylon-fiber (point-target) phantom. Axes: batch, time samples, array elements, steering angles. DC removal is applied later in preprocessing. |
| `RF_cysts`  | (1, 1536, 128, 7) | float32 | RF signals in raw 8-bit ADC counts, circular-cyst phantom. Same axis order; acquisition starts at t₀ = 5×10⁻⁵ s after the first transmit. |

No `ground_truth.npz` is provided for this task; image quality is evaluated via lateral resolution (FWHM of point-spread function at each wire target) and contrast-to-noise ratio (CNR) of each cyst. `data/baseline_reference.npz` contains the reference Stolt f-k B-mode images for NCC/NRMSE evaluation.

### `data/baseline_reference.npz`

| Key | Shape | Dtype | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bmode_fibers` | (1, 2688, 128) | float32 | Reference B-mode image, nylon-fiber phantom (Stolt f-k, 7 angles compounded), arbitrary display units |
| `bmode_cysts`  | (1, 1536, 128) | float32 | Reference B-mode image, circular-cyst phantom (Stolt f-k, 7 angles compounded), arbitrary display units |

### `data/meta_data.json`

| Key | Shape | Dtype | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `dataset_1` | object | JSON object | Fibers acquisition metadata: `description`, `c` (m/s), `fs` (Hz), `pitch` (m), `TXangle_deg` (degrees), `TXangle_rad` (radians), `t0` (s), `n_elements`, `n_samples`, `n_angles` |
| `dataset_2` | object | JSON object | Cysts acquisition metadata with the same fields and units as `dataset_1`; here `t0 = 5×10⁻⁵ s` |

The analytic Gaussian blur in tests is a mathematical unit check only.

Paper: Michelle K. Croughan, Ying Ying How, Allan Pennings, Kaye S. Morgan, Directional dark-field retrieval with single-grid x-ray imaging, Optics Express 31(7), 11578-11597, published version 2023, DOI https://doi.org/10.1364/OE.480031 . Author reference repository: https://github.com/Xray-grill/DiDaFi_MKCroughan , remotely verified revision ef998eaf39021a98fae2bb8ff0bddfdd1493a4e7 (archived didafi_commit.json). Its BSD-3-Clause license is preserved verbatim as task LICENSE. Original source copyright is retained. The author repository supplies the measured PMMA dataset under Diffusive_DF_data/Grid/PMMA with the repository-wide BSD license and no file-specific contrary license; its README explicitly identifies supplied example and associated dark-field data. This is an existing author-distributed real measurement dataset, not newly generated observations or a paper figure digitization. The associated diffusive dark-field acquisition is distinguished from claiming that every ROI is the directional paper's printed figure.

Data URLs at the fixed revision are https://github.com/Xray-grill/DiDaFi_MKCroughan/tree/ef998eaf39021a98fae2bb8ff0bddfdd1493a4e7/Diffusive_DF_data/Grid/PMMA . Original files are Flats_00.tif, GridA_00.tif, GridA+Sample_00.tif, float32 2136 by 2544. Fixed rows 900:1368 and columns 1000:1468 were selected before the oracle. Public counts and flat retain float32 exactly and gain a batch axis only. The period 12.68550106609808 was obtained using the original Fourier calibration on the full grid-only observation; no sample or hidden field enters this legitimate reference calibration. Dark=0 and unity exposure normalization are assumptions, not measured camera calibrations. Missing detector pitch and propagation distance prevent converting the moments into angular variance; units remain detector-pixel squared.

data_source.description:
The input is `data/raw_data.npz`; all arrays include batch size one.

| Key | Shape | Dtype | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `angular_frequency` | `(1, 100)` | `float64` | Native angular frequency in rad/s. |
| `storage_modulus` | `(1, 100)` | `float64` | Measured storage modulus G prime in Pa. |
| `loss_modulus` | `(1, 100)` | `float64` | Measured loss modulus G double-prime in Pa. |

**Acquisition metadata**

| Parameter | Value | Unit | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Frequency convention | Angular frequency | rad/s | Do not multiply the supplied coordinate by 2π |
| Measurement channels | Storage modulus G prime and loss modulus G double-prime | Pa | Positive linear-viscoelastic response |
| Native observations | 100 frequency pairs | 1 | Entire author-curated Watanabe binary linear-blend example |
| Fluid plateau | 0 | Pa | Selected dataset/model has no equilibrium elastic term |
| Continuous output grid | tau_min*ratio^j, j=0..99 | s | tau_min=exp(-π/2)/omega_max; tau_max=exp(π/2)/omega_min; ratio=(tau_max/tau_min)^(1/99) |
| Continuous quadrature | Trapezoidal in ln(tau) | 1 | Spectrum density integrates with logarithmic measure |
| Fitted output frequency grid | 100 geometric points from min to max native angular frequency | rad/s | Linear interpolation of measured moduli at those points |
| Discrete representation | 13 modes, sorted by increasing relaxation time | 1 | Fixed output capacity for this bound selected model |
| Noise covariance | Not supplied | Pa² | Relative-residual formulation handles large modulus range |

data_source.description:
The first acquired time point at every deposited stage position is retained, with all native defocus planes and the complete detector region. Empty-field images and the instrument-response settings were calibrated independently of the specimen.

| Key | Shape | Dtype | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| intensities | (1, 3, 4, 16, 128, 256) | uint16 | Raw analyzer intensities in ADU; axes batch, position, analyzer state, defocus, row, column |
| background | (1, 4, 128, 256) | float64 | Independent no-sample analyzer images, ADU; axes batch, analyzer state, row, column |
| instrument_matrix | (1, 4, 4) | float64 | Analyzer response A, dimensionless; rows State0 through State3, columns Stokes s0 through s3 |

**Acquisition metadata**

| Parameter | Value | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| Wavelength | 532 | nm | Incident light wavelength |
| Analyzer scheme | 4-State | dimensionless | State0, State1, State2, State3 order |
| Liquid-crystal swing | 0.1 | wave | Calibration retardance swing |
| Dark offset | 100.58 | ADU | Measured camera black level, subtract from specimen and background |
| Extinction ratio | 164.47 | dimensionless | Independently measured polarimeter extinction |
| Exposure | 10.0 | ms | Specimen page metadata; background exposure not deposited |
| Objective | 20x, NA 0.55, dry | dimensionless | Actual microscope page hardware metadata |
| Defocus spacing | 2.0 | micrometer | Native z step, planes 0 through 15 |
| First recorded z | 197.5 | micrometer | Stage-z coordinate in specimen page metadata |
| Detector region | 128 by 256 | pixel | Complete native recorded region |
| Lateral object-plane pitch | Not reliably deposited | unavailable | Page PixelSizeUm is zero; use detector pixels rather than inventing micrometer distances |
| Stage positions | 0, 1, 2 | index | Original deposited position order |
| Included time point | 0 | zero-based index | First complete acquired time point |
| Coordinates | x increases right, y increases down | detector pixel | No orientation rotation or flip |
| Spatial boundary | Per-pixel retarder model | dimensionless | No spatial convolution or wraparound |
| Saturation | Zero samples at 65535 | sample | No detector clipping in the bound acquisition |
| Noise variance | Not calibrated | unavailable | Preserve noisy P estimates, including values above one |

data_source.description:
`data/raw_data.npz` preserves all50native author images after the original arithmetic mean of their three RGB channels. It contains no newly generated observations.

| Key | Shape | Dtype | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| measurements | (1, 50, 256, 256) | float64 | Grayscale relative image intensity, dimensionless author units; axes batch,light,row,column. |
| light_directions | (1, 50, 3) | float64 | Calibrated distant-light direction/intensity vectors, dimensionless, Cartesian x,y,z. |
| support | (1, 256, 256) | bool | Observed foreground silhouette, dimensionless; True marks requested unit normals. |

**Acquisition metadata**

| Parameter | Value | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| Image size | 256 by256 | pixel | Full native observation grid; no spatial crop or resizing. |
| Illumination count | 50 | 1 | All rows of the supplied illumination array, in measurement order. |
| Viewpoint | Fixed orthographic | 1 | The surface remains in the same image coordinates under all lights. |
| RGB conversion | Arithmetic mean of three original channels | 1 | Linear grayscale intensity convention already applied. |
| Exposure scale | Author-relative, unchanged | 1 | Do not normalize each frame independently. |
| Light convention | Diffuse dot product with supplied Cartesian vectors | 1 | Retain vector magnitudes and signs; no coordinate reorientation. |
| Surface support | Supplied observed silhouette | 1 | Foreground is reconstructed; background must be zero. |
| Non-diffuse effects | Existing specularities and shadows | relative intensity | Unknown additive departures from the diffuse model. |
| Calibrated stochastic noise | Not supplied | 1 | No known Gaussian variance or photon count is asserted. |
| Pixel pitch | Not specified | 1 | Recover orientation on the native index grid, not metric depth. |
| Spatial boundary | Pixelwise inverse | 1 | No external spatial boundary values are required. |

The original unwrapped phase band is retained in float32, and all spatial axes preserve the source raster order. ERA5 delay is an independently computed weather-model product supplied with the original dataset; it is a legitimate external correction input, not a target-derived calibration.

The baseline sensitivity uses the complete-scene mean slant range and mean sine of incidence, rather than an unannounced pixelwise geometry replacement. The distributed observations were already multilooked, filtered and spatially unwrapped by their data provider; reconstructing SAR focusing or generating new interferograms is outside this inverse problem.

data_source.description:
The public archive contains the complete original processed Sentinel-1 observation stack, without synthetic additions, spatial subsampling or a reduction in acquisition dates. The original unwrapped phase band is retained in float32, and all spatial axes preserve the source raster order. ERA5 delay is an independently computed weather-model product supplied with the original dataset; it is a legitimate external correction input, not a target-derived calibration.

| Key | Shape | Dtype | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `phase` | `(1, 288, 450, 600)` | float32 | Original unwrapped phase, rad; batch, edge, azimuth, range |
| `coherence` | `(1, 288, 450, 600)` | float32 | Spatial interferometric coherence, dimensionless; same axes |
| `components` | `(1, 288, 450, 600)` | uint8 | Original connected-component labels, dimensionless; zero means unavailable |
| `dates` | `(1, 98)` | int32 | Ordered acquisition dates as YYYYMMDD, calendar dates without a physical unit |
| `pairs` | `(1, 288, 2)` | int16 | Zero-based first/second indices into `dates`, dimensionless |
| `baseline` | `(1, 98)` | float32 | Perpendicular baseline relative to the first acquisition, m; mean of the two supplied swath baseline values |
| `atmospheric_delay` | `(1, 98, 450, 600)` | float32 | Original ERA5-derived LOS displacement contribution, m; subtract after spatial/temporal re-referencing |
| `incidence` | `(1, 450, 600)` | float32 | Original incidence angle, degrees; azimuth, range |
| `latitude` | `(1, 450, 600)` | float64 | Original pixel latitude, degrees north |
| `longitude` | `(1, 450, 600)` | float64 | Original pixel longitude, degrees east |
| `analysis_mask` | `(1, 450, 600)` | bool | All-edge observation-availability mask, dimensionless; 159,762 valid pixels |

**Acquisition metadata**

| Parameter | Value | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| Sensor / orbit | Sentinel-1 A/B, descending track 128, VV | dimensionless | Radar platform, viewing track and polarization |
| Acquisition interval | 20141213 to 20180619 | calendar date | All 98 dates retained |
| Interferogram count | 288 | dimensionless | All original temporal edges retained |
| Frame shape | 450 by 600 | pixel | Complete original distributed scene |
| Wavelength | 0.05546576 | m | Phase-to-LOS conversion wavelength |
| Azimuth pixel spacing | 78.08212603857966 | m | Original multilooked sampling |
| Range pixel spacing | 34.94343172072985 | m | Original multilooked slant-range sampling |
| Starting slant range | 799547.2189154713 | m | Column zero range; column $x$ has this value plus $x$ times range spacing |
| Azimuth / range looks | 5 / 15 | dimensionless | Original acquisition processing |
| Heading | -168.01821899414062 | degree | Original satellite heading |
| Reference pixel | row 76, column 156 | zero-based pixel | Original reference point; latitude about -0.30, longitude about -91.43 degrees |
| Original raster subset origin | row 1150, column 1070 | source raster pixel | Original dataset preparation; no further crop is applied here |
| Spatial axes | increasing source azimuth row, increasing slant-range column | dimensionless | Use supplied geolocation for geographic interpretation |

### data/raw_data.npz

| Key               | Shape                      | Dtype   | Description |
|-------------------|----------------------------|---------|-------------|
| response_matrix   | (1, N_slopes, 150)         | float32 | Push-pull calibrated DM→slope response matrix [slope/m] |
| wfs_images        | (1, 4, 128, 128)           | float32 | Raw SH-WFS detector images at each WFE level [photons] |
| ref_image         | (1, 128, 128)              | float32 | Reference (flat wavefront) SH-WFS image [photons] |
| detector_coords_x | (1, 128, 128)              | float32 | Focal-plane x coordinate per pixel [m] |
| detector_coords_y | (1, 128, 128)              | float32 | Focal-plane y coordinate per pixel [m] |
| subap_map         | (1, 128, 128)              | int32   | Subaperture rank per pixel (−1 = invalid, 0..N_valid−1) |
| dm_modes          | (1, 150, N_pupil_px)       | float32 | DM mode shapes on the 128×128 pupil grid (disk harmonics, ptp-normalised) |
| aperture          | (1, N_pupil_px)            | float32 | Pupil transmission mask (128×128 px) |

N_slopes = 592 (296 valid subapertures × 2).
N_pupil_px = 16384 (128×128 pupil grid).
The 4 WFE levels (from `meta_data.json`) are 50, 100, 200, 400 nm RMS.

### data/ground_truth.npz

| Key              | Shape             | Dtype   | Description |
|------------------|-------------------|---------|-------------|
| wavefront_phases | (1, 4, N_pupil_px) | float32 | True wavefront phase at each WFE level [rad at λ_WFS = 700 nm] |

The ground-truth phase is a random DM mode combination scaled to the target RMS.
Because the ground truth lies in the DM mode subspace, perfect reconstruction is
in principle achievable in the noise-free limit.

data_source.description:
### data/raw_data.npz

Preprocessed NGC 1300 galaxy data used as source input for the simulation pipeline.

| Key | Shape | Dtype | Description |
|-----|-------|-------|-------------|
| `coeff_ngc` | `(1, 11476)` | `float32` | Shapelet coefficients from decomposing NGC 1300 at $n_{\max}=150$, $\beta_s=10$ pixels |
| `ngc_resized` | `(1, 264, 264)` | `float32` | Downsampled (25x) and Gaussian-smoothed galaxy image in counts |
| `image_reconstructed` | `(1, 264, 264)` | `float32` | Galaxy image reconstructed from shapelet coefficients in counts |

### data/ground_truth.npz

Ground truth source image and lens model parameters (known from simulation).

| Key | Shape | Dtype | Description |
|-----|-------|-------|-------------|
| `source_image` | `(1, 320, 320)` | `float32` | Intrinsic (unlensed) high-resolution source image at 0.01 arcsec/pixel in counts |
| `theta_E` | `(1,)` | `float64` | Einstein radius of the SIS lens model in arcsec |
| `gamma` | `(1,)` | `float64` | Power-law slope of the SPEP lens model (2.0 = SIS) |
| `source_x` | `(1,)` | `float64` | Source center x-offset in arcsec |
| `source_y` | `(1,)` | `float64` | Source center y-offset in arcsec |

### data/meta_data.json

Imaging and instrument parameters for the forward model. Contains: detector geometry (`numPix=64`, `deltaPix=0.05` arcsec/pixel), PSF specification (`fwhm_lensing=0.1` arcsec, `fwhm_deconv=0.25` arcsec), noise parameters (`background_rms=10` counts, `exp_time=100` s), supersampling factor (`high_res_factor=5`), and lens parameters ($\theta_E=0.5$ arcsec, $\gamma=2.0$, zero ellipticity and shear).

data_source.description:
`data/raw_data.npz` — 2D localisations from a fixed BCR (B-cell receptor) B cell, imaged on a hexagonal FLFM. Localised using ImageJ GDSC SMLM2 PeakFit plugin.

| Key | Shape | Dtype | Description |
|-----|-------|-------|-------------|
| `localizations_2d` | (150996, 35) | float32 | Raw PeakFit localisation array bundled with the task |

The bundled NPZ stores the original PeakFit-style columns. During loading,
`src.preprocessing.load_localizations` converts the required subset into the
standardised internal `(N, 8)` array used by the pipeline:
- raw **0** → frame index
- raw **9** → X position (pixels, converted to μm via `pixel_size_sample`)
- raw **10** → Y position (pixels, converted to μm via `pixel_size_sample`)
- raw **12** → sigma_X / sigma_Y (pixels, converted to μm)
- raw **8** → intensity (photons)
- raw **7** → background (photons)
- raw **13** → precision (nm, converted to μm)

Internal standardised layout after loading:
- **0** frame index
- **1** X position (μm)
- **2** Y position (μm)
- **3** sigma_X (μm)
- **4** sigma_Y (μm)
- **5** intensity (photons)
- **6** background (photons)
- **7** precision (μm)

> **Note**: No `ground_truth.npz` is provided for this task — the data comes from
> real experimental recordings with no simulation ground truth.

- **150,996 localisations** in **5,000 frames**
- Hexagonal MLA: 7 views in the back focal plane
- 60× water-immersion objective, NA 1.27

Source: `hexSMLFM` repository (TheLeeLab, University of Cambridge).
Reference paper: [R. R. Sims et al., Optica 7, 1065 (2020)](https://doi.org/10.1364/OPTICA.397172)

data_source.description:
The movie blocks are ordered as source blocks 1, 10, and 20. They are separate intervals of the same acquisition; all original spatial pixels and all frames of each block are retained.

| Key | Shape | Dtype | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| intensities | (1, 3, 200, 450, 450) | uint16 | Recorded fluorescence camera values, ADU; axes batch, block, frame, detector row, detector column |

**Acquisition metadata**

| Parameter | Value | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| Label | Dronpa-C12 fused to beta-actin | dimensionless | Reversibly blinking fluorescent protein |
| Sample | Live HeLa cell | dimensionless | Experimental biological specimen |
| Frames per block | 200 | frame | Complete short movie per reconstruction |
| Source block indices | 1, 10, 20 | block | Ordered intervals; no assumption of adjacency |
| Detector field | 450 by 450 | pixel | Full native field, no resize |
| Detector bit depth | 16 | bit | Unsigned intensity storage |
| Coordinates | x is column increasing right; y is row increasing down | pixel | Pixel centers at integer coordinates |
| Temporal lag | 0 | frame | Requested equal-time central moments |
| Spatial boundary | No spatial filtering or wraparound | dimensionless | Statistics evaluated independently at each detector pixel |
| Absolute pixel pitch and inter-block timing | Not deposited in the bound TIFF metadata | unavailable | Report distances in detector pixels; do not infer absolute resolution or dynamics speed |
| Noise calibration | Not supplied | unavailable | Counts are observed ADU, not calibrated photon counts |

data_source.description:
The observation is the complete native equal-area GONG synoptic magnetic map for Carrington rotation 2234. No pixel downsampling or field crop is applied.

| Key | Shape | Dtype | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| magnetogram | (1, 180, 360) | float32 (big-endian FITS precision preserved) | Measured photospheric radial magnetic field in G; axes batch, sine latitude increasing south-to-north, Carrington longitude increasing from the stated edge. |

| Parameter | Value | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| Instrument | NSO-GONG network | identifier | Magnetic synoptic image product |
| Map observation time | 2020-09-01T13:04:00 | UTC | Last contributor epoch; map is assembled over time |
| Carrington rotation | 2234 | dimensionless | Rotation identifier |
| Diagnostic wavelength | 676.8 | nm | Photospheric spectral line |
| Number of contributing files | 7391 | count | Original image metadata |
| Projection | Cylindrical equal area | dimensionless | Uniform longitude and sine-latitude sampling |
| Longitude edge | 22.0 | degree | Western edge; centers offset by half a degree |
| Longitude spacing | 1.00000 | degree | Original stored increment |
| Sine-latitude increment in original header | 0.0111111 | dimensionless | Original decimal metadata, retained verbatim |
| Exact full-sphere grid increment | 2/180 | dimensionless | Full-sphere finite-volume coordinate definition |
| First axis center reference pixel | 180.500 | pixel | One-based original WCS convention |
| Second axis center reference pixel | 90.5000 | pixel | One-based equatorial reference |
| Central reference longitude | 202 | degree | Original WCS reference value |
| Inner shell radius | 1 | solar radius | Photospheric boundary |
| Outer shell radius | 2.5 | solar radius | Radial-field source-surface assumption |
| Grid and boundary conditions | 35 log-radius cells; periodic longitude; regular poles | dimensionless | Required finite-volume output geometry |
| Noise model | Not supplied | G | Instrument noise and synoptic evolution are not an independent known Gaussian variance |

The observations are four unaltered 17-by-17 cutouts from a public Spitzer GLIMPSE channel-2 mosaic. They preserve the mosaic surface-brightness scale. Conversion from FITS storage to float64 NPZ changes neither image sampling nor brightness values. The separate flight calibration is supplied in its original sampling and values.

| Key | Shape | Dtype | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| images | (1, 4, 17, 17) | float64 | Observed survey surface brightness in MJy/sr; axes batch, patch, row, column |
| flight_psf | (1, 81, 81) | float64 | Independent focus-star PSF samples, dimensionless normalized calibration weights; axes batch, row, column |

**Acquisition metadata**

| Parameter | Value | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| Telescope / instrument | Spitzer / IRAC channel 2 | dimensionless | Infrared survey instrument |
| Nominal wavelength | 4.5 | micrometre | Channel band designation |
| Survey product | GLM_01800+0000_mosaic_I2 | dimensionless | Processed GLIMPSE mosaic; not raw detector exposures |
| Mosaic creation | 2006-12-02 | UTC date | FITS product creation date |
| Mosaic pixel scale | 1.2 | arcsec/pixel | Both output image axes |
| Native frame pixel scale | 1.213 | arcsec/pixel | Single-exposure sampling before mosaicking |
| FITS effective integration time | 1.2 | s | Exposure metadata; not an independent noise variance for the mosaic |
| Flight PSF pixel spacing | 0.30325 | arcsec/sample | Fourfold oversampling of native detector pixels |

| PSF center and support | (40,40); 81 by 81 | calibration samples | Zero-based center, exact spline inside grid and zero outside |

| Native PSF interval | x[−7.4906,7.4438],y[−7.489,7.383] | um | Actual native coordinates supplied |

imaging parameters:

| Parameter | Value | Description |
|-----------|-------|-------------|
| `volume_shape` | [308, 256, 256] | Nz x Ny x Nx voxels |
| `res_um` | [0.1, 0.1, 0.1] | Voxel size in micrometers (dz, dy, dx) |

| `NA` | 0.65 | Objective numerical aperture |
| `n_angles` | 8 | Number of illumination angles |
| `ri_contrast_scale` | 0.01 | RI contrast scaling factor |

### Illumination Geometry

8 LED positions uniformly distributed on a ring at NA = 0.65 (annular IDT).
Each LED approximates a plane wave with direction:

$$
k_x^{in} = \text{NA} \cdot \cos(2\pi m / 8), \quad k_y^{in} = \text{NA} \cdot \sin(2\pi m / 8), \quad m = 0, \ldots, 7
$$

| Parameter | Value | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| Spectrometer | TeraSmart, Menlo Systems | — | Transmission time-domain instrument |
| Incidence | 0 | degree | Normal to nominally parallel pellet faces |
| Reference thickness | 2.56 | mm | Independently measured polyethylene thickness |
| Mixed-pellet thickness | 2.65 | mm | Independently measured lactose/polyethylene thickness |
| Pellet diameter | 13 | mm | Pressed pellet diameter |
| Lactose nominal mass fraction | 5 | wt% | Mixture composition; output refers to whole mixed pellet |
| Acquisitions averaged | 1000 | — | Each released measured waveform |
| Atmosphere | nitrogen purge | — | Empty path approximated by nonabsorbing na=1 |
| Nominal temporal spacing | 0.03333333 | ps | Exact coordinates are in time_ps; use their individual mean spacings |
| Scan extent | approximately−30.1483 to70.0850 | ps | Exact acquisition endpoints are in time_ps |
| Field gain | common relative instrument scale | — | No independently adjustable channel normalization |
| Geometry approximation | isolated single-pass, homogeneous slab | — | Suppress delayed etalons; omit scattering and coherent re-reflections |
| Noise | measured, no supplied parametric variance | — | Do not infer hidden noise calibration |

| Parameter | Value | Unit | Meaning |

Creates a 128x128 speed-of-sound phantom with tissue-like inclusions,
converts to slowness perturbation relative to water background, computes
travel-time sinograms via the Radon transform, adds noise, and saves.

The forward model operates on the slowness perturbation
delta_s = s - s_water = 1/c - 1/c_water, which is zero outside the
object. This avoids artifacts from the circular reconstruction support
of the Radon transform.

`data/raw_data.npz` contains real repository-provided camera measurements converted from the original 8-bit PNGs without synthetic noise or new simulated observations.

| Key | Shape | Dtype | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| observation | (1, 169, 137, 3) | float64 | Blurred photograph I; batch,row,column,BGR; original integer camera values divided by 255, dimensionless. |
| background | (1, 169, 137, 3) | float64 | Registered independent static-background photograph B; same axes and intensity units as I. |

**Acquisition metadata**

| Parameter | Value | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| Spatial sampling | 1 | pixel | Original image pixel grid; no resampling. |
| Crop | rows [315,484), columns [718,855) | pixel | Same fixed region of the original observation and background. |
| Original intensity encoding | 8-bit camera values / 255 | dimensionless | Retains encoded camera scale; no undocumented linearization or white balance. |
| Channel order | blue, green, red | channel | Retains the upstream OpenCV input convention. |
| Object support | 36 by 36 | pixel | Approximate observed diameter, not a sharp target-derived calibration. |
| Compact-array origin | index (18,18) before embedding | pixel | Zero-based spatial center, shifted to the Fourier origin. |
| Boundary model | circular convolution on 169 by 137 grid | pixel | Matches the selected discrete inverse model; crop margin reduces edge effects. |
| Background registration | same crop and grid | pixel | Assumed static scene and camera. |
| Exposure duration | not supplied | second | Only a normalized exposure occupancy can be inferred. |
| Pixel pitch / focal length | not supplied | meter | No metric speed or 3D position is requested. |
| Noise distribution | not characterized | normalized intensity | Real camera noise and modeling residuals; no known Gaussian/Poisson scale is asserted. |

references: Real observation source: NASA LAMBDA WMAP DR5 nine-year1degree-smoothed native HEALPix band temperature maps,v5,release2012-11-11. Public product page https://lambda.gsfc.nasa.gov/product/wmap/dr5/maps_band_smth_r9_i_9yr_get.html . Five exact URLs,source byte counts and SHA256 hashes are in private `wmap_downloads.json`; native source tables contain TEMPERATURE(float32,mK thermodynamic) and N_OBS. Only TEMPERATURE is bound. Native source NSIDE512,NESTED is preserved during nearest-pixel sampling of a fixed48x64direction patch: requested longitude linspace(70,102,64),latitude linspace(12,36,48),degrees. Private Astropy-HEALPix converts those requested directions to native indices; it does not interpolate or convolve observations. Data are native source float32 values promoted exactly to float64 and multiplied by1000to change mK to microkelvin. This does not claim added precision. The requested direction arrays locate the native pixel containing each direction; they are not relabeled exact native pixel-center positions. No foreground-reduced image,component template,hidden answer,seed or reconstructed target is supplied. Native source maps already share1degree smoothing; this operation and its pixel correlations are not attributed to local reconstruction. No new data generator is needed or shipped.
